sources.title: $500,000 in AbbVie and Gilead Could Pay More Than $11,000 a Year in Dividends
sources.snippet: One drugmaker's earnings look broken on paper, while the other carries negative equity and a mountain of new debt. Both still hand retirees raises every year, so why would anyone trust them with half a million dollars?

sources.title: Is Solid Tumor Partnership Altering The Investment Case For AbbVie (ABBV)?
sources.snippet: AbbVie and German biotech Disco Pharmaceuticals announced a collaboration to co-develop AND gated bispecific therapies for solid tumors, with Disco receiving US$40 million upfront and eligibility for up to US$2.5 billion in milestones plus tiered royalties. The deal adds external oncology technology on top of AbbVie's internal research programs, indicating an effort to broaden its solid tumor pipe
